findings.evidence: Lines 131-142 state `Over.pullback (Spec.map (𝟙 R)) ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec R))` and `Over.pullback (Spec.map (f ≫ g)) ≅ Over.pullback (Spec.map f) ⋙ Over.pullback (Spec.map g)` — no `Grp`/`IsAffine` occurs. Existing non-group-scheme consumers of the same pattern: `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/AbelianVariety/Basic.lean:275`, `AbelianVariety/Hom/BaseChange.lean:58`, `AbelianVariety/Trivial.lean:296` all use `Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))`.
findings.fix: Move both defs (and their `Spec.map` rewriting) to a scheme-level home earlier in the dependency order, e.g. a new `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/PullbackSpecMap.lean` under a scheme-level namespace, and import it here; keep only the group-object/affineness material in `AffineGroupScheme/BaseChange.lean`.
findings.issue: `pullbackSpecMapIdIso` (line 131) and `pullbackSpecMapCompIso` (line 139) mention no group object and no affineness — they are statements about `Over.pullback (Spec.map ·)` on schemes over `Spec R`, depending only on Mathlib's `Over.pullbackId`/`Over.pullbackComp` and `Spec.map_id`/`Spec.map_comp` — yet they live in a file about affine group schemes and in namespace `TauCeti.AffineGroupSchemeCat`, so any consumer of scheme base change must import affine group schemes to reach them.

summary: The file itself is correctly placed in the existing AffineGroupScheme/ subdirectory and both imports are used and appropriately narrow, but the two pullback comparison isomorphisms are generic scheme-level material buried in the AffineGroupSchemeCat namespace and file.
